14957.en: Recall that P(1) and U(1) are the 1st and 2nd Brocard points, given in trilinears by P(1) = \(c/b : a/c : b/a\) and U(1) = \(b/c : c/a : a/b\). In barycentrics, P(1) = 1/\(c^{2}\) : 1/\(a^{2}\) : 1/\(b^{2}\) and U(1) = 1/\(b^{2}\) : 1/\(c^{2}\) : 1/\(a^{2}\). The point X_14957 is obtained as in the definition, in the preamble just before X_14953, by taking P = P(1) and U = U(1), or, to yield the same result, by taking P = U(1) and U = P(1).
